overview_title: What Is the Best Yucatán and Riviera Maya Itinerary?
answer: The best Yucatán and Riviera Maya itinerary, as James Wild & Co draws it, is ten days between two Chablé hotels: three nights at Chablé Yucatán, the hacienda in the Mayan forest near Mérida, three at Mezzanine Tulum, above the sea inside Tulum's protected Jaguar Park, and three at Chablé Maroma, seventy private pool villas on Maroma Beach. Fly into Mérida (MID) and home from Cancún (CUN), with every leg by private car.

days.title: Mérida to the Mayan forest
days.line: By road from Mérida airport · about 45 to 50 minutes
days.body: Land at Mérida International Airport (MID). Chablé Yucatán is about 45 to 50 minutes away by road, and private transfers are available. The hacienda sits in the Mayan forest, and every casita has its own pool.

days.title: The cenote spa
days.line: Chablé Yucatán, in the Mayan forest
days.body: The cenote spa and the Chablé Spa Journeys, then the Melipona bee sanctuary on the estate.

days.title: The Mayan kitchen
days.line: Chablé Yucatán, in the Mayan forest
days.body: A Mayan kitchen class, cycling and the cenotes around the hacienda. Families are welcome here, with a Kids Club.

days.title: Yucatán to Tulum
days.body: By private car from Chablé Yucatán to Tulum. Mezzanine sits at Km 4.4 on the Tulum to Boca Paila road, inside Jaguar Park, a protected area between the jungle and the Caribbean, steps from the Mayan ruins. Guests are asked to follow the park's guidelines on access and preservation.
days.move: By road · drive time set with your dates

days.title: Ruins, cenotes and Sian Ka'an
days.body: Mezzanine's own packages go to the cenotes, the ancient canals, the Mayan ruins and Sian Ka'an.
days.acts: Cenotes · canals · the ruins · Sian Ka'an

days.title: Thai on the cliff
days.body: A day for the view and the beach below, dinner on the cliffside Thai terrace, and Hotel Mi Amor, the sister property three minutes away, with its restaurant and infinity pool.
days.acts: Beach · Thai terrace · Hotel Mi Amor

days.title: Tulum to Maroma Beach
days.line: By road up the Riviera Maya
days.body: North by private car to Chablé Maroma on Maroma Beach: seventy villas designed by Paulina Morán in a protected stretch of jungle, each with a private terrace, a plunge pool and the Chablé moon shower.
days.move: By road · drive time set with your dates

days.title: The water ceremony

days.title: Jorge Vallejo's table
days.body: A last day on the private beach, and Jorge Vallejo's cooking at every table.

days.title: Home from Cancún
days.line: By road to CUN · about 35 to 40 minutes
days.body: Chablé Maroma is about 35 to 40 minutes by car from Cancún International Airport (CUN), and Chablé can arrange the private transfer.

getThere.title: In at Mérida, Out at Cancún
getThere.intro: Fly into one airport and home from another, with the peninsula crossed by private car. Transfer times are given only where the hotel publishes them.
points: Chablé Yucatán is about 45 to 50 minutes by road from Mérida International Airport, with private transfers available.
Chablé Yucatán to Tulum, and Tulum to Maroma Beach, are by private car. Neither leg has a published drive time, so James sets them when he plans your dates.
Chablé Maroma is about 35 to 40 minutes by car from Cancún International Airport, and Chablé can arrange private transfers.
Mezzanine lists Tulum International (TQO), about 45 km and 45 to 60 minutes away, for the shortest transfer, and Cancún, about 120 km and 2 to 2.5 hours, for the widest choice of flights.

lodges.name: Chablé Yucatán
lodges.body: A hacienda in the Mayan forest near Mérida, with casitas that each have a private pool, a cenote spa, a Melipona bee sanctuary and a Mayan kitchen. Chablé names it for couples, honeymooners and wellness travellers; families are welcome with a Kids Club.
rows: In the Mayan forest near Mérida, Yucatán
Casitas with private pool, family, presidential and royal villas
Mérida International Airport (MID), about 45 to 50 minutes by road; private transfers available
November to April, the dry season

lodges.name: Mezzanine Tulum
lodges.body: A small hotel above the sea, one of the few inside Jaguar Park, the protected stretch of Tulum between the jungle and the Caribbean, steps from the Mayan ruins. Three room categories, a Thai kitchen on the cliffside terrace and packages to the cenotes, canals and Sian Ka'an.
rows: Carretera Tulum to Boca Paila Km 4.4, inside Jaguar Park
Penthouse with plunge pool, sea view room, interior room
Tulum (TQO) 45 to 60 minutes; Cancún (CUN) 2 to 2.5 hours; transfers booked by the concierge
November to April, the dry season as Mezzanine describes it

lodges.name: Nômade Temple Tulum
lodges.line: Tulum · the family choice for Days 4 to 6
lodges.body: On the beach where the Mayan jungle meets the Caribbean, with breathwork, ice baths, stargazing and yoga, live music through the week and three restaurants. Families are welcome, with family rooms and a two-bedroom villa with its own pool.
rows: Carretera Tulum to Boca Paila Km 10.5
3 · Days 4 to 6, in place of Mezzanine
Cancún (CUN), 130 km, about 2 hours by road; private transport booked at least 48 hours ahead

lodges.name: Chablé Maroma
lodges.body: Seventy villas by Paulina Morán in a protected stretch of jungle on Maroma Beach, each with a private terrace, a plunge pool and the Chablé moon shower, a private beach on the Caribbean and Jorge Vallejo's cooking at every table.
rows: Treetop, Jungle and Serenity Pool Villas
About 35 to 40 minutes by car from Cancún (CUN); private transfers arranged by Chablé
December to April, warm and dry

lodges.name: Nômade Temple Holbox
lodges.body: A wellness retreat on Holbox Island, where the Caribbean meets the Gulf of Mexico, inside the Yum Balam Nature Reserve: thirty rooms through three levels of jungle, from canvas-walled Moon Temple rooms to treehouses.
rows: Holbox Island, Yum Balam Nature Reserve
From Cancún (CUN), 2 to 2.5 hours by road to Chiquilá port, then about 30 minutes across to Holbox

faqs: What is the best Yucatán and Riviera Maya itinerary?

Ten days and nine nights: three at Chablé Yucatán near Mérida, three at Mezzanine Tulum inside Jaguar Park and three at Chablé Maroma on Maroma Beach, flying into Mérida (MID) and home from Cancún (CUN).
How do you get to Chablé Yucatán?
Fly to Mérida International Airport (MID). The hacienda is about 45 to 50 minutes away by road, and private transfers are available.
How far is Chablé Maroma from Cancún airport?
About 35 to 40 minutes by car from Cancún International Airport (CUN). Chablé can arrange private transfers.
When is the best time to go?

December to April suits all three stays. Chablé Yucatán and Mezzanine name November to April, the dry season, and Mezzanine calls May to October the wet season. Chablé Maroma names December to April, warm and dry.

Mezzanine Tulum takes guests aged 16 and over. For a family, James books Nômade Temple Tulum instead, which welcomes all ages, with family rooms and a two-bedroom villa with its own pool. Chablé Yucatán has a Kids Club.
Yes. Nômade Temple Holbox is an adults-only (18+) retreat inside the Yum Balam Nature Reserve. From Cancún it is 2 to 2.5 hours by road to Chiquilá port, then about 30 minutes across to the island.
Has James stayed at these hotels?
James inspected Chablé Yucatán and Chablé Maroma in person and approved both in 2026. He has not stayed at Mezzanine Tulum or Nômade Temple Tulum; both are filed from the hotels' own information.
How much does this route cost?
It is quoted against your dates and travellers. James Wild & Co does not publish a fixed price for this route.
